name: Onna Kishi Frey ~Shokushu Ryoujoku no Nie~
original_name: 女騎士フレイ ～触手陵辱の贄～
source:
There was a proud knight, and a priest of lofty morality who saved people from despair. When they gave in to the evil, their sexual desire deep inside themselves begun to awake....
